parsed.reason: Description A says the retry catches all GatewayError, including permanent errors like CardDeclined, so declined cards are retried needlessly. Description B says that after retries are exhausted the method breaks out of the loop and implicitly returns None, swallowing the final error so callers crash later. These are different defects: one concerns which exceptions are retried, the other the return value after exhaustion.
